title: Files on S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage or a local disk: destination

url.title: URL
url.description: Where the tables go: s3://bucket/prefix, gs://bucket/prefix and azblob://container/prefix (from 0.2.0), or file:// and an absolute path. Each stream's table is a directory of files under it.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: The store's endpoint, for one other than its cloud's own: an S3-compatible store's (with path-style addressing), the Google Cloud Storage JSON API's, such as an emulator's, or the Azure blob service's URL, such as Azurite's http://127.0.0.1:10000/devstoreaccount1. Not for file:// URLs.

accessKeyId.title: Access key ID
accessKeyId.description: S3: an AWS access key. Without one, the AWS default credentials.

serviceAccountKey.title: Service account key
serviceAccountKey.description: Google Cloud Storage: a service account's JSON key, as its text. Without one, Google's default credentials, or none at all with an endpoint, as an emulator takes. From 0.2.0.

accountName.title: Account name
accountName.description: Azure Blob Storage: the storage account. Needed with accountKey, sasToken or Azure's default credentials, unless the endpoint names it. From 0.2.0.

accountKey.title: Account key
accountKey.description: Azure Blob Storage: the account's shared key. Set at most one of accountKey, sasToken and connectionString; without any, Azure's default credentials. From 0.2.0.

sasToken.title: SAS token
sasToken.description: Azure Blob Storage: a shared access signature for the container, the query string it is. From 0.2.0.

connectionString.title: Connection string
connectionString.description: Azure Blob Storage: the account's connection string, which names the account and its key or a SAS. From 0.2.0.

format.title: Format
format.description: The files' format: Parquet, CSV with a header line, or JSON Lines. From 0.2.0.

compression.title: Compression
compression.description: Parquet: zstd (the default), snappy, gzip or none, inside the file. CSV and JSON Lines, from 0.2.0: gzip, zstd or none (the default), the whole file, which gets the extension .gz or .zst.

fileSize.title: File size
fileSize.description: Bytes a file reaches, compressed, before the next one starts.

x-groups.title: Location
x-groups.description: Where the files are, and the address of the store's API.

x-groups.title: Amazon S3
x-groups.description: For s3:// URLs: the region and keys.

x-groups.title: Google Cloud Storage
x-groups.description: For gs:// URLs: the service account.

x-groups.title: Azure Blob Storage
x-groups.description: For azblob:// URLs: the account and its credentials.

x-groups.title: Files
x-groups.description: How each table's files are written.
